verdict.rationale: Zep's docs show messages and data are ingested into a user-level knowledge graph (Context Graph) with entity and edge extraction. Custom Pydantic-like entity and edge types are supported, and retrieval runs over nodes and edges. Community evidence confirms the deliberate shift to graph-based memory to fix poor recall. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or benchmarks showing multi-hop graph traversal or multi-hop question answering (search is described as semantic plus BM25), and independent hands-on corroboration of entity-centric query quality.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can store memories as a knowledge graph of entities and relationships so multi-hop and entity-centric questions are answerable
